decisions.reason: A quantified customer saving well above what management would view as an acceptable early-market result, and in a growing, innovation-active firm with slack there is little reason to redeploy these resources elsewhere.

As a close extension of the established range with dedicated website presentation, B likely meets aspiration levels or is near enough that the firm would continue backing it rather than terminate it after only one year.

C has weaker market evidence than A and may still be below aspiration, but the firm’s growth, R&D orientation and strategic push toward modular solutions make continued trial and learning more likely than withdrawal.

D is close to the core business and fits the firm's screening and processing portfolio, so absent clear signs of failure management would probably retain it while using organisational slack to assess its market potential.
